{{recipesummary|category=Meat recipes|servings=4|time=½ hour|difficulty=2}}

{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Meat|Meats]]

==Ingredients==
* 4 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. (about 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]]) [[Cookbook:Chicken#Breast|chicken breasts]], thinly-[[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* Freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]]
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:All-purpose flour|all-purpose flour]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Vegetable Oil|vegetable oil]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] chicken [[Cookbook:Broth|broth]]
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Vodka|vodka]] or [[Cookbook:Vermouth|vermouth]] (optional)
* Juice of 1 [[Cookbook:Lime|lime]]
* 2 tbsp [[Cookbook:Jalapeño|minced pickled jalapeños]]
* 1 can (15 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]] [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Cornstarch|cornstarch]]
* 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Water|cold water]]
* 2 tbsp [[Cookbook:Chop|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Cilantro|fresh cilantro]]

==Procedure==
# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven_temperatures|200°F]].
# Season both sides of each chicken breast with salt and pepper.
# Place the flour on a plate and [[Cookbook:Dredging|dredge]] the chicken breasts through it, lightly coating both sides.
# Set aside.
# In a large [[Cookbook:Skillet|skillet]] heat the oil over a medium-high heat.
# Add the breasts and cook 3 minutes, or until lightly browned.
# Flip and cook another 2–3 minutes, or until cooked through.
# Transfer the chicken to an oven-proof plate and place in the oven to keep warm.
# Return the empty skillet to the burner.
# Increase the heat to high and add the chicken broth and vodka to [[Cookbook:Deglazing|deglaze]] the pan.
# As the liquid bubbles, scrape the bottom of the pan with a [[Cookbook:Wooden Spoon|wooden spoon]]
# Add half of the lime juice and the jalapeños and cook 30 seconds.
# Add the tomatoes and bring to a [[Cookbook:Simmer|simmer]].
# In a small glass, add the cornstarch to the water, then add to the skillet.
# Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened, about 2 minutes.
# Remove the skillet from the heat.
# Stir in remaining lime juice.
# Arrange each chicken breast on a plate and top with pan sauce.
# [[Cookbook:Garnish|Garnish]] with cilantro.
